## Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible effect.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant Python, Vue and/or Rust tests pass.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and documentation are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, real school data or proprietary code are included.
- [ ] New dependencies/assets have compatible licenses.
- [ ] Build, release and signing changes identify their artifact and trust-boundary impact.

## Signing impact

State whether this changes build provenance, signed file names, PE/MSI metadata, packaging, updater signatures or SignPath artifact configuration. Write `None` when it does not.
